scope: 47 unique exposure-cancer-PMID rows removed from the default served Extracted Studies tables; 50 physical cache records because some rows occurred in more than one cache variant.
interpretation: Displayed effect/sample/case values are historical table values. The short source excerpt verifies the article context and usually demonstrates why the cached row did not support those values.

rows.removal_note: Valine estimate concerns breast-cancer recurrence, not incidence.
rows.source_excerpt: high valine level was significantly negatively associated with recurrent breast cancer (aHR: 0.36, 95% CI: 0.18-0.72
rows.source_verification_note: The estimate is for valine and breast-cancer recurrence among previously diagnosed patients, not cancer incidence.

rows.source_verification_note: The primary endpoint was pain improvement during CBD treatment for aromatase-inhibitor symptoms; 43.6% is a response proportion, not an incidence RR.

rows.source_verification_note: The exposure is copper-containing intrauterine-device use and the outcome is invasive cervical cancer, not uterine/endometrial cancer.

rows.removal_note: Source estimate is for a CYP17 genotype, not DHEA exposure.
